body.name: Two-plane cylindrical Hamiltonian lower family
body.construction: Fix the empty graph \(G_0\), the identity decoder \(f_0\), uniform observational and baseline densities \(p_0^{\mathrm{obs}}=q_i^0=1\) with respect to \(\lambda^n\) and \(\lambda\), and \(q_i^1(t)=Z_i^{-1}\exp\{b_i\gamma_m(t)\}\), where \(Z_i=\int_{\mathbb T}\exp\{b_i\gamma_m(t)\}d\lambda(t)\) and \(0<b_1<\cdots<b_n<1\). Then the log-ratio derivatives have exact order \(m\) at zero. In the injective chart \((-R_0,R_0)^2\times\mathbb T^{n-2}\), write \(x_{12}=(x_1,x_2)\), \(r=|x_{12}|\), and \(\alpha_h(r)=\tau h^{k-1}\eta(r^2/h^2)\) for \(0<h<R_0/2\). Define \(\Psi_h(x)=(\operatorname{Rot}(\alpha_h(r))x_{12},x_3,\ldots,x_n)\) on the cylinder \(\{r<h\}\times\mathbb T^{n-2}\) and \(\Psi_h(x)=x\) outside it. The cutoff makes the chart extension smooth, \(\Psi_h^{-1}\) is obtained by replacing \(\alpha_h\) by \(-\alpha_h\), and \(\det D\Psi_h=1+(\nabla\alpha_h)^\top J_2x_{12}=1\). For \(0\le j\le k\), \(\lVert D^j(\Psi_h-\mathrm{id})\rVert_\infty+\lVert D^j(\Psi_h^{-1}-\mathrm{id})\rVert_\infty\le C\tau h^{k-j}\). Let \(\theta_0=(G_0,p_0,q_0,f_0)\) and \(\theta_h=(G_0,p_0,q_0,f_0\circ\Psi_h^{-1})\).
